premises.text: Hydrogen offers a better balance of energy efficiency and aircraft range/speed/payload than batteries or sustainable aviation fuel
premises.evidence_span: hydrogen in the middle has good enough energy efficiency and a good enough aircraft performance

premises.text: Electrifying aviation should start with light aircraft and business jets before scaling to regional and commercial platforms
